user.title: Connect to Contact Energy
user.description: Enter your Contact Energy account credentials and preferences.

data_description.account_id: The email address you use to log into the Contact Energy app / My Account
data_description.first_day_history: The first day of historical data to import
data_description.delta_no_data_days: On each update, re-request this many days before today (Contact data often lags). Default: 2.
data_description.refresh_interval: How often to poll Contact for new data (hours). Default: 24.
data_description.refresh_start_time: Local time of the first daily poll. Further polls are every refresh interval after this (e.g. 03:00 with 12h → 03:00 and 15:00). Default: 03:00.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Contact Energy services. Please try again later.

data_description.refresh_start_time: Local clock time for the first poll each day. Other runs are offset by the refresh interval. Default: 03:00.
data_description.delta_no_data_days: On each update, re-request this many days before today (Contact data often lags).
